status_correction.the_earlier_claim_was_too_strong: the earlier gap check injected the failure at the FIRST publication, before the marker and the stamp were touched, and the same injection fired again during the rollback. The comparison of the unchanged metadata therefore did NOT prove that the metadata is restored. The correct status was: the rewriting of the predecessor is eliminated; the late rollback still needed proof.
status_correction.what_is_now_proved: the one-shot injection at a LATE point - the publication of the install stamp, AFTER the marker was written - reaches that point, and after the refusal every watched file (the receipt, the marker, the stamp and the published project file) has its previous bytes AND its previous mode, while the historical predecessor's record is untouched.
